english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for getting used to a new situation, environment, or condition.
Use this when a person or group changes their behavior or state to fit new circumstances.

examples.english: After moving to a new home, it took me a few weeks to adjust.
examples.traditional: 搬咗去新屋之後，我用咗幾個星期先適應到。
